description: A-F risk grade for one XRP Ledger lending vault or loan broker, from on-ledger data only (size, utilization, first-loss cover ratio, late/impaired/defaulted loans, unrealized loss, realized yield), with every rule that moved the grade. Not a credit rating. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.02 USDC on Base at GET /api/lending/grade. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not compute the grade. NOT LIVE YET: it goes live when XRPL lending (the LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault amendments) is enabled on mainnet. Until then this tool returns available:false and GET /api/lending/grade returns 503 with no charge. Params: id (64-hex Vault or LoanBroker ID, required); type (vault | broker, optional).

id.description: 64-hex ledger ID of an XRPL Vault or LoanBroker. Required.

name: lending_grade
